item.title: 【Introductions & Farewells】Salutations Media Enthusiast!
item.description:
Hello, just wanna introduce myself and say Thanks!
Came across your site as I scoured the interwebs for Tay-Tay tracks I couldn't source elsewhere, but were abundant here...
*Amazing speeds, vibrant community, active postings.*
I have a voracious desire to contribute to a wonderful community as a way to show my appreciation.
With my steadily growing collection of music docs, movies, and music. Of course if not already posted.

Toodles!
